label: Backend dev server
command: sh -c 'if [ -f deploy/.env ]; then set -a; . deploy/.env; set +a; fi; mkdir -p data config && BYTEWING_APP_URL=http://localhost:8080 BYTEWING_DATA_DIR=$PWD/data BYTEWING_CONFIG_DIR=$PWD/config exec go run ./cmd/bytewing'

label: Go checks
command: sh -c 'go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest ./...; vuln_status=$?; go run github.com/securego/gosec/v2/cmd/gosec@latest -exclude-dir=internal/db/sqlcgen -exclude=G703 ./...; gosec_status=$?; exit $((vuln_status || gosec_status))'
